description: A Product Operations Lead must finalize the retirement plan for a legacy public API, including the retirement date, compatibility period, and customer migration support, after the routine release-readiness review.

shared_context.S1: The public v1 reporting API is currently targeted for retirement on September 30.
shared_context.S2: Riley makes the final call on the retirement plan and records the commitments for the release program.
shared_context.S3: The replacement v2 reporting API is available and has passed the documented compatibility tests.
shared_context.S4: As part of the normal release-readiness process, Riley reviews the plan with API platform and customer success before it is finalized.

PF1.text: Owen confirmed with the account team this morning that the Northstar contract requires 60 days of notice before the v1 reporting API is retired and guarantees access through November 14; he found the clause while preparing a renewal brief and has not yet added it to the release record.

PF2.text: Mina confirmed while reviewing mobile telemetry today that the current mobile SDK still calls v1 for 38% of reporting requests, and SDK 6.4 will not reach the required adoption level until November 10; v1 must therefore remain dual-served through November 14, with a migration clinic needed for affected application teams, but she has not filed the platform note yet.

acceptance_conditions: The retirement date must be November 15.
The plan must require customer notice.
The v1 API must remain dual-served through November 14.
A migration clinic for affected application teams must be committed.
The contract notice constraint must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'customer_notice' and c['target'] == 'Northstar' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'migration_clinic' and c['target'] == 'affected application teams' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The contract changes the retirement date from September 30 to November 15, turns customer notice from optional to required, and requires a Northstar-specific notice commitment.
The mobile SDK adoption numbers change compatibility from immediate v1 retirement to dual-serving through November 14 and add a migration clinic for affected application teams.
